newsitem.title: USA: FNB to acquire Home Savings Bank.
newsitem.headline: FNB to acquire Home Savings Bank.

text.p: FNB Corp said on Tuesday it has agreed to acquire Home Savings Bank of Siler City Inc for $15.50 a share in stock and cash.

Home Savings shareholders will be able to elect stock or cash or a combination thereof, subject to the limitation that FNB common stock issued in the merger will be no more than 60 percent and not less than 50 percent of the total consideration, FNB said.
FNB said the merger is intended to be tax-free with respect to the FNB stock issued and taxable with respect to the cash paid in the transaction.

The acquisition will be accounted for as a purchase transaction and is subject to several conditions, including an affirmative vote of the majority of Home Savings' shareholders and approval from applicable regulatory agencies, FNB said.
Completion of the transaction is expected in the first quarter of 1998.
FNB said it has received an option to purchase 19.9 percent of Home Savings' common stock. The option is exercisable only under certain specified conditions.
